candidateReviews.finding: The retained MacRumors states directly bracket the public update on November 14 Pacific: the 13:02:49 article state says the seed was still developer-only, while the archived state captured at 14:55:46 contains the explicit public-beta update. Independent ThinkApple and Taisy0 reports were published later that same Pacific day. The later Neowin 'today' wording is preserved as a contrary November 15 reporting position, but it cannot move the already observed first appearance forward.

Taisy0 explicitly identifies iOS 10.2.1 Public Beta 3 for beta testers and its full JST timestamp normalizes to January 9 Pacific, independently corroborating the retained MacRumors lineage. Kobonemi is unnecessary to close the gate and remains supplementary because its title and product string conflict with erroneous prose ordinals.

Preserve the original Japanese source, JST timestamp, Pacific normalization, and original-synthesis translation summary together.
